say:0:1220401001:0.text: It's Lucca! Looks like he's in trouble with that angry crowd!
say:0:1220401001:0.source_cn: 呀，是卢卡！他被一群人围住了，他们一定是在威胁他！

say:1:1220401002:0.text: Actually, Chippy thinks they're the ones in trouble. Let's go see!
say:1:1220401002:0.source_cn: 我觉得是他在威胁那些人……主人，咱们去看看热闹吧！
say:1:1220401002:0.male: Actually, Chippy thinks they're the ones in trouble. Let's go see!
say:1:1220401002:0.female: Actually, Chippy thinks they're the ones in trouble. Let's go see!
